subject.title: feat: add account feed model API

question: Should ClawHub commit to both account-scoped and publisher-scoped public v1 feed APIs in this first slice, including the proposed bounded and non-paginating contract?
rationale: Source review can identify the compatibility defect, but only maintainers can decide whether the dual identity surface and first-version pagination semantics are the intended durable public API.

options.title: Approve after compatibility repair
options.body: Keep both endpoint families, require canonical legacy-publisher resolution and live HTTP proof, then approve the public contract explicitly.

options.title: Start publisher-only
options.body: Narrow the first release to publisher detail and feed endpoints until a concrete account-scoped consumer establishes the second identity surface.

options.title: Pause the feed contract
options.body: Hold the PR until the consuming OpenClaw discovery workflow and pagination requirements are specified end to end.

recommendation.title: Approve after compatibility repair
recommendation.body: Keep both endpoint families, require canonical legacy-publisher resolution and live HTTP proof, then approve the public contract explicitly.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to the catalog and package API direction that the proposed feed contract extends.
